name: Ravindra Chat Forms
author: ravistm26

sections.description:
Ravindra Chat Forms lets you build your own WhatsApp-ready forms directly inside WordPress. You can add a WhatsApp number, customize the form title and button text, and create the fields you want for your business.
The plugin includes a built-in field builder so you can add text, email, phone, number, textarea, select, radio, checkbox, URL, and date fields without coding. When a visitor submits the form, their answers are formatted into a WhatsApp message and opened directly in WhatsApp.
This makes it useful for inquiries, bookings, product requests, lead capture, and support forms where you want structured details before the chat begins.

Key Features:

Create your own WhatsApp form fields inside WordPress
Support for text, email, phone, number, textarea, select, radio, checkbox, URL, and date fields
No coding skills required
Fast and direct form submission to WhatsApp
Ideal for inquiries, bookings, leads, and customer support
Lightweight and easy to use

Whether you run a small business website, service-based company, eCommerce store, or personal blog, Ravindra Chat Forms makes it simple to connect your website visitors directly to your WhatsApp for real-time communication.

This plugin helps you turn website visitors into direct conversations, making your communication process faster, smoother, and more efficient.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ravindra-chat-forms directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Tools > Ravindra Chat Forms and add your WhatsApp number.
  4. Create the fields you want to show in the form and save the settings.
  5. Use the [ravindra_chat_forms] shortcode in your posts or pages.
  6. Optional: you can set the form width, e.g., [ravindra_chat_forms width="100%"].
sections.changelog:
2.0.0

  • Rebuilt the plugin as a native WhatsApp form builder inside WordPress.
  • Added admin settings under Tools to configure WhatsApp number, form title, description, and button text.
  • Added a dynamic field builder with support for text, email, phone, number, textarea, select, radio, checkbox, URL, and date fields.
  • Added support for multi-option select, radio, and checkbox fields using one option per line.
  • Updated the shortcode output to render the form directly on the site and open WhatsApp in a new tab.
  • Improved WhatsApp message formatting for cleaner enquiry details.

1.0

  • Initial release.
